newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Ridley prepared to raise Joe White bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Ridley prepared to raise Joe White bid.

text.p: Ridley Corp said on Monday it was prepared to make a friendly takeover bid for Joe White Maltings Ltd of an effective A$5.90 per share.
The offer compares with the latest hostile bid of A$5.44 per share, which includes a 14-cent per share dividend payment.
Ridley said the potential increase in the offer would be based on the inclusion of a share component and a change to the cash offer price.
"However, this change can only happen if the Joe White board provides Ridley with an indication that the revised offer would receive a favourable recommendation from them," Ridley said.

It said a friendly bid would consist of two Ridley shares, A$2.36 cash and the continued entitlement to the 14 cent dividend. The company said the latest offer represented a 53 percent premium to the first offer pitched at A$3.85 per share and a 51 percent premium to net tangible asset backing.

"Ridley believes that this proposal is fair and generous and hopes that the Joe White board will take whatever steps it can to deliver this outstanding value to Joe White shareholders," Ridley chief executive Gary Busenshut said.
Busenshut said Ridley's offer had been extended until November 1 and Ridley must receive a response by October 18.
Joe White shares ended steady at A$5.38 while Ridley shares fell one cent to A$1.69.
